units.claim: Non-ASCII or long GUI text input should use Unicode clipboard paste instead of direct SendKeys typing so execution is independent of the active Windows IME.
validation: Gemini received complete Traditional Chinese prompts after Unicode clipboard paste.

units.claim: Absolute web navigation should use desktop.open_url rather than keyboard entry into the browser address bar.
validation: Keyboard URL entry was corrupted by input state; desktop.open_url opened Threads successfully.

units.claim: When a web composer accepts pasted images, prefer clipboard image paste before native file-picker automation.
units.scope: Web social composers that support image paste
validation: Native file picker automation repeatedly failed; clipboard image paste produced a visible remove-media control in Threads.

units.claim: A GUI action is not complete when the click/keystroke returns; require a semantic postcondition before advancing.
validation: Download and publish steps required explicit file/toast/profile verification to distinguish invocation from completion.

promotion_note: Do not promote to trusted/canonical until a later independent execution loads these units and demonstrates measurable uplift.
